content:
maria_cs: FYI Greenline just flagged a noticeable drop in their rerank relevancy after the Feb 12 runtime rollout. They're seeing ~12% drop in NDCG on their eval set and p95 latency up ~40%. Customer is unhappy and asking for next steps. sample queries below and logs attached. Can product/ML triage?

jordan_support: Ack — opening intake ticket and pinging PM/ML.

ticket-bot: Created ticket PROD-8593 and linked to this thread.

jon_product: Thanks @maria_cs. Can you paste a short reproducible sample + the customer SLA/priority? Is this Dedicated or Hosted? Any config changes we pushed for them in the rollout?

maria_cs: Dedicated (reserved). They were on embed-large-v2 and we rolled a runtime patch that prefers q4 quantized variants for cost/throughput. They claim quality regressed after the patch. SLA: standard enterprise (99.9) — they're escalated to executive. Quick sample: 

```
query: "best onboarding checklist for fintech SaaS"
gold: doc123, doc456
customer_topk_before: [doc123, doc789, doc456]
customer_topk_after: [doc789, doc999, doc000]
```

Metrics snapshot from their telemetry (last 7 days): avg_rerank_ndcg: 0.68 -> 0.60, avg_query_latency_ms: 210 -> 295, p95_latency_ms: 430 -> 620

ali_se: Noted — they were routed to the quantized variant (embed-large-v2-q4) to reduce cost per token. Quantization can change embedding geometry; if they've got tight thresholds in the reranker or an index tuned for the float variant, recall can drop. Two quick asks: 1) can they revert to the float variant for the customer as a mitigation? 2) share index type (faiss/product) + current index params (nprobe, top_k)

maria_cs: I'll ask for explicit permission to switch them back and to share indices. They said they can accept a short SLA blip if it recovers relevancy. They gave permission to run experiments on a copy of their index.

sam_ml: I'll take this. Early hypotheses: (A) quantization altered cosine distances -> lower recall for certain clusters, (B) index params need retuning (nprobe) after quantization. Can you get me 500 labeled queries and the embedding vectors (or a sample)? I can run a delta eval and an index reindex locally. If I get the data now I can have results in ~24-48h.

ali_se: For mitigation without rollback: bump top_k from 30 -> 100 and run rerank on those 100. That usually recovers recall at higher CPU cost. Also increase nprobe from 8 -> 32 for IVF indexes. If they want absolute quality, reverting to the float variant is the fastest path.

jon_product: Sounds like a P1 customer-impact. I'm marking this as high priority. Acceptance criteria for product ticket: 
- Reproduce delta on our eval harness vs customer's labeled set.
- Determine root cause (quantization vs index param drift).
- Provide mitigation path: (a) immediate rollback to float variant OR (b) index retune recipe + SRE-approved config.
- Customer-facing timeline and rollback plan.

maria_cs: Customer gave sample set (500 queries) and granted permission for a reindex test on a copy. Sending S3 link in DM.

sam_ml: Got the samples. Running baseline eval: embedding model variants (float vs q4), and index param sweep (nprobe 8/16/32, top_k 30/50/100). Will post results to the ticket.

jon_product: If it's quantization, we should add an automatic verification step to the rollout gating: run 1k eval queries and verify NDCG within 2% of baseline before auto-switch. Adding to backlog as a follow-up if confirmed.

ali_se: Also adding a temporary customer route: set model pin for Greenline to the float variant while we investigate (ops change). That buys us time. Ops, can we do that today?

jordan_support: Ops confirmed we can pin model for single customer. I'll create a change request and link to PROD-8593. ETA 3-4 hours to run with minimal disruption.

ticket-bot: PROD-8593 linked to change request CHG-4042.

jon_product: Great. Sam — after your local eval, if quantization proves to be the cause, we need a proposed rollout policy: a) per-customer canary to float when delta > X, b) auto-detect poor NDCG and rollback. Add cost/ops tradeoffs to the ticket.

sam_ml: Will include delta numbers and a recommended gating threshold. If quantization impact is small but index tuning fixes it, we'll produce a parameter recipe. If it's systemic, propose we keep q4 opt-in only after per-customer eval.

maria_cs: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Greenline + PM/ML at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks team. :pray:

jon_product: Thanks all — I updated PROD-8593 with the acceptance criteria and linked it to product backlog under labels [customer:greenline, area:embeddings, priority:high]. See you tomorrow.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll post customer updates and escalate to AE/CS leadership.

jordan_support: Closing the loop here, will post when pin is complete.

maria_cs: Pin completed, customer onboarded to float variant. Preliminary feedback: relevancy looks improved on quick check. Sam — please prioritize the eval and next steps.

sam_ml: Acknowledged, starting full delta eval now. Expect initial results within 24h.

jon_product: Sweet — we'll keep this thread for updates.

maria_cs: TY everyone, marking follow-ups in the ticket.
